post.summary: Enroll a contact in a drip
post.description:
**Required scope:** `campaigns:manage`

Beta. Adds one contact to a running or paused drip whose `drip.enrollment` is `continuous`. The contact starts at the first step, subject to the drip's send window, pacing and caps. Idempotent per phone: a phone already in the drip, including one that finished or left, returns its existing enrollment with `created: false`. An opted-out phone is enrolled as `skipped` and never sent. A team without the drip sequences beta gets `403 feature_unavailable`; a campaign that is not a drip, or a drip that is not accepting enrollments, answers `409 state_conflict`.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `campaigns:manage`

Starts a draft campaign. It begins sending at `scheduledAt`, or right away when no start time is set. Launch checks the saved sender selection against live plans: `402 campaigns_not_entitled` when a selected number is missing or its plan does not include Campaigns, or when an unselected campaign's project has no such number; `400 invalid_parameter` on `senderConfig.sessionIds` when a selected number is not connected or the selection mixes sending types; `400 campaign_throughput_capped` when a requested throughput is above its ceiling. Segment campaigns require a team API key; project tokens answer `403 permission_denied`, and unavailable audience betas answer `403 feature_unavailable`. An audience change during launch answers `409 state_conflict`. Segment evaluation that exceeds its time limit also answers `409 state_conflict`; simplify the rules and retry. A launched campaign whose segment was deleted remains launched and cannot be launched again (`409 state_conflict`). A message that references a `{{link:<key>}}` the campaign does not define, or tracked links on a campaign that would send from Official API numbers, answers `400 invalid_parameter` on `trackedLinks`; tracked links without the campaign link tracking beta answer `403 feature_unavailable`. A drip without a sendable composed message answers `400 invalid_parameter` on `messagesArray`. Saving a draft does not apply this check. The template must be complete and approved on every Cloud API number; every recipient needs a value or fallback for each variable unless `skipMissingVariables` is true. When the team requires approval above a recipient threshold and the launch would send to more recipients, it answers `409 campaign_approval_required`, sends nothing, and records a pending approval request for a team owner or admin. Launching again with the campaign unchanged returns the same request. A launch requested by an AI agent through the hosted MCP server is held the same way, whatever the threshold. The response returns the campaign as it was when the launch was accepted.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key, 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8, that makes this write safe to retry for 24 hours. A retry with the same key, credential, `Polymorfa-Version`, and request never runs the write again: it returns `409 idempotency_completed` when the original succeeded, or the original server error, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Reusing the key for a different request returns `409 idempotency_conflict`; a retry while the original is still running returns `409 idempotency_in_progress`, and a retry after an unrecorded outcome returns `409 idempotency_outcome_unknown`.

400.description: `invalid_parameter` naming the field: an unconnected or mixed sender selection (`senderConfig.sessionIds`), an incomplete or authentication template (`templateId`), a composed attachment without a public URL, or a `{{link:<key>}}` the campaign does not define or tracked links on Official API numbers (`trackedLinks`). `campaign_throughput_capped` when a requested throughput is above its ceiling; `template_not_approved` when a Cloud API number has not approved the template.

402.description: `campaigns_not_entitled`: a selected number is missing or its plan does not include Campaigns, or the project has no number on such a plan. Drafts are saved on every plan.

error.message: This number’s plan does not include Campaigns.

A launched campaign whose segment was deleted cannot be launched again.. The Idempotency-Key already succeeded (`idempotency_completed`), was used for a different request (`idempotency_conflict`), belongs to a request that is still running (`idempotency_in_progress`, with Retry-After), or belongs to a request whose outcome was not recorded (`idempotency_outcome_unknown`)
